errors.general: Something went wrong inside Chausar. Try again; if it happens again, send a report from the business menu.
errors.UNLOCK_FAILED: That passphrase didn't open it. Check Caps Lock and try again, or use your recovery code.
errors.VAULT_CLOSED: This business is closed. Open it again from the list.
errors.VAULT_EXISTS: A business is already kept in that place. Pick an empty one.
errors.REENTRANT_TRANSACTION: Chausar was still saving something. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CUSTODY_SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED: Chausar was still saving something. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.BOOTSTRAP_STATE_CHANGED: Something went wrong inside Chausar. Try again; if it happens again, send a report from the business menu.
errors.UI_NOT_BUILT: Phone access isn't ready in this copy of Chausar. Reinstall Chausar, then try again.
errors.WEAK_PASSPHRASE: Use a passphrase of 12 to 1024 characters.
errors.UNSAFE_PATH: Chausar can't use that place. Choose a folder on this computer that isn't a shortcut or the top of a drive.
errors.OUTPUT_EXISTS: A file with that name is already there. Choose another name or folder.
errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: This business changed somewhere else just now. Try again.
errors.VAULT_TOO_LARGE: This business is too big to save in one piece. Nothing was lost. Send a report from the business menu.
errors.VAULT_BUSY: This business is already open in another Chausar window. Close it there, then try again.
errors.ARTIFACT_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: That saved copy doesn't match this business, so Chausar didn't use it. Nothing here changed.
errors.ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND: That saved copy isn't there any more.
errors.BACKUP_OTHER_BUSINESS: This backup belongs to another business.
errors.TRANSFER_CODE_WRONG: That code doesn't open this file. Check it and try again.
errors.INVALID_BACKUP: That file isn't a backup Chausar made. Choose one of your Chausar backups.
errors.SYNC_CORRUPT: That copy is damaged, so Chausar didn't use it. Nothing here changed.
errors.SYNC_FAILED: The copy didn't reach your other computer, and Chausar didn't try again. Try again when you're ready.
errors.client.offline: Chausar isn't answering right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.client.phoneOffline: The computer isn't answering. Check that this phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
errors.client.unpaired: This browser isn't connected to Chausar. Open the link from your Chausar app again.
